grid.comparison_reference: The best valid result from the complete 20-configuration Grid is the quality reference for later algorithms.
grid.limited_budget_comparison: If canonical Grid prefixes of 4, 8 and 12 are reported, label them as order-dependent; the optimization-level-outer and block-size-inner order can bias prefix quality.
grid.rule: Evaluate all 20 canonical configurations exactly once at the configuration level.

prefix_rule: For each seed, run one 12-evaluation trajectory; budgets 4 and 8 are prefixes of that same trajectory.

random_restart_greedy.accept: After the available neighborhood is evaluated, move to the strictly lower-score best neighbor; break equal scores by canonical order.
random_restart_greedy.grid: The two axes are the listed optimization levels and block sizes.
random_restart_greedy.information_constraint: It may reuse its own prior observations but may not read Grid, another algorithm, or another seed's results.
random_restart_greedy.neighbor_order: Shuffle the current point's unevaluated neighbors using the same seeded RNG, then evaluate them in that order.
random_restart_greedy.neighbors: Change exactly one parameter to any other legal value: three alternative optimization levels plus four alternative block sizes, for seven unique neighbors at every point.
random_restart_greedy.restart: If no strict improvement exists, restart uniformly from all unevaluated configurations.
random_restart_greedy.start: Choose uniformly from all unevaluated configurations using the search seed.
random_restart_greedy.stop: Stop when the unique-evaluation budget is exhausted or no unevaluated configuration remains.

random_without_replacement.information_constraint: The strategy may use only measurements from its own evaluated prefix.
random_without_replacement.rule: Apply a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle to the 20 canonical configurations and evaluate in that order.

revision_reason: P1-R1 external review corrected the greedy neighborhood before any formal Grid or stochastic search was run.
